faqs.question: Where is CX Technology based and how can we contact you?
faqs.answer: CX Technology is based in Rajkot, Gujarat, India. You can reach our team directly at cx@gmail.com for any inquiries regarding website development, software engineering, or AI/ML solutions.

faqs.question: What core development services does CX Technology provide?
faqs.answer: CX Technology provides three primary specialized services: 1) Website Development (custom responsive websites, web applications, UI/UX animations), 2) Custom Software Development (enterprise SaaS, microservices, secure backend systems, APIs), and 3) AI & Machine Learning Development (custom ML algorithms, predictive analytics, NLP, generative AI, and automation pipelines).

faqs.question: How do we get started on a project with CX Technology?
faqs.answer: Simply contact us by emailing cx@gmail.com or choosing a development plan on our website. Our technical team in Rajkot, Gujarat will review your requirements, schedule an introductory scoping session, and provide a detailed roadmap and estimate.

faqs.question: Do you offer post-launch maintenance and technical support?
faqs.answer: Yes, all our website, software, and AI/ML development deliverables come with full warranty, technical documentation, ongoing maintenance, and direct support from our Rajkot-based engineering team.
